# Data for Battelle

```{r}
( cce_access = cce %>% 
  dplyr::select(fire_scar, site, year, latitude_at_0m, longitude_at_0m) %>%
  group_by(fire_scar, site) %>%
  summarise(year = paste(unique(year), collapse = ", "),
            latitude_at_0m = paste(unique(latitude_at_0m), collapse = ", "),
            longitude_at_0m = paste(unique(longitude_at_0m), collapse = ", ")) %>%
  mutate(latitude = str_extract(latitude_at_0m, "^[^,]+"),
         longitude = str_extract(longitude_at_0m, "^[^,]+")) %>%
  mutate(access = ifelse(fire_scar %in% c("Aggie Creek", "Hess Creek", "Isom", "Munson Creek", "Nugget Creek"), "Truck", 
                         ifelse(fire_scar %in% c("Lost Horse", "Haystack"), "Truck & ATVs", "Helicopter"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(latitude_at_0m, longitude_at_0m, year)) %>%
  mutate(latitude = as.numeric(latitude),
         longitude = as.numeric(longitude),
         network = "CCE") 
    
)
```

```{r}
( ak04_access = ak04_1 %>%
  dplyr::select(burn, site, lat, lon) %>%
  rename(latitude = lat, longitude = lon, fire_scar = burn) %>%
    mutate(site = as.character(site)) %>%
  mutate(access = "Truck",
         network = "2004") )
```
```{r}
( access = bind_rows(cce_access, ak04_access) )
```

## Function to make points

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
df_to_sf <- function(x){
  st_as_sf(x, coords = c("longitude_at_0m","latitude_at_0m"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
}
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
df_to_sf <- function(x){
  st_as_sf(x, coords = c("lon","lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
df_to_sf <- function(x){
  st_as_sf(x, coords = c("longitude","latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
}
```

# Fairbanks point with buffer

64.8436° N latitude and 147.7231°



# For illustration (delete once you plug in real data):
```{r}
hubs <- st_as_sf(
  data.frame(
    name = c("Coldfoot", "Fairbanks", "Delta Junction"),
    lon  = c(-150.1783, -147.7164, -145.7331),
    lat  = c(67.2524, 64.8378, 64.0378)
  ),
  coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326
)

hubs_sf <- st_as_sf(hubs, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Reproject, buffer, reproject back
hubs_proj <- st_transform(hubs_sf, crs = 3338)
buffer_dist_m <- 100 * 1609.34
hubs_buffer_sf <- st_buffer(hubs_proj, dist = buffer_dist_m)
hubs_buffer_sf_wgs84 <- st_transform(hubs_buffer_sf, crs = 4326)

```

```{r}
# Fairbanks, AK coordinates
# Fairbanks, AK coordinates
df <- data.frame(id = 1, name = "Fairbanks", lon = -147.7164, lat = 64.8378)
point_sf <- st_as_sf(df, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Reproject, buffer, reproject back
point_proj <- st_transform(point_sf, crs = 3338)
buffer_dist_m <- 100 * 1609.34
buffer_sf <- st_buffer(point_proj, dist = buffer_dist_m)
buffer_sf_wgs84 <- st_transform(buffer_sf, crs = 4326)

# Interactive map with both layers
mapview(buffer_sf_wgs84, col.regions = "steelblue", alpha.regions = 0.3, layer.name = "100mi radius") +
  mapview(point_sf, color = "black", col.regions = "black", layer.name = "Fairbanks, AK") +
  mapview(access_pts, zcol = "access", layer.name = "access")
  #mapview(helo_pts, color = "red", col.regions = "red", layer.name = "helo") +
  #mapview(truck_pts, color = "yellow", col.regions = "yellow", layer.name = "truck")
```

```{r}

#3. MAIN MAP
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# annotation_map_tile() pulls an OSM-style basemap (needs internet access
# when you run this). Swap "cartolight" for "osm", "hotstyle", etc.
 
# --- Basemap: Esri topo-style tiles (closer match to the reference PDF) ---
# annotation_map_tile() (ggspatial/rosm) can only reach OSM-family servers,
# which look different from your PDF's Esri-style terrain/refuge basemap.
# maptiles can pull Esri tiles directly. Common providers to try:
#   "Esri.WorldTopoMap"    - closest match to your PDF (terrain + labels)
#   "Esri.NatGeoWorldMap"  - National Geographic style, also close
#   "Esri.WorldStreetMap"  - plain street map, no terrain shading
#   "CartoDB.PositronNoLabels" - light, minimal (previous default)
 
access_colors <- c(  "Helicopter"   = "#FF7F00",
  "Truck"   = "#FF91A4",
  "Truck & ATVs"  = "#ff6666")

# --- Fix for cut-off sites: compute combined extent of buffers + sites ---
full_extent <- st_bbox(
  st_union(st_geometry(hubs_buffer_sf_wgs84), st_geometry(access_pts))
)
 
# Pad the extent ~5% on each side so points aren't flush against the edge
pad_x <- (full_extent["xmax"] - full_extent["xmin"]) * 0.05
pad_y <- (full_extent["ymax"] - full_extent["ymin"]) * 0.05
full_extent["xmin"] <- full_extent["xmin"] - pad_x
full_extent["xmax"] <- full_extent["xmax"] + pad_x
full_extent["ymin"] <- full_extent["ymin"] - pad_y
full_extent["ymax"] <- full_extent["ymax"] + pad_y
 
# Basemap tile fetch — bbox must be in the format maptiles expects (a bbox obj)
basemap_tiles <- get_tiles(
  x = st_as_sfc(full_extent) %>% st_set_crs(4326),
  provider = "Esri.WorldTopoMap",
  zoom = 7,          # increase for more detail (slower), decrease for coarser/faster
  crop = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
( main_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster_rgb(data = basemap_tiles) +
  geom_sf(data = hubs_buffer_sf_wgs84, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.35,
          color = "steelblue4", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_sf(data = access_pts, aes(fill = access),
          shape = 21, size = 2.2, color = "white", stroke = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = access_colors, name = "Access Type") +
  geom_sf(data = hubs_sf, shape = 24, size = 4,
          fill = "purple", color = "black") +
  geom_sf_text(data = point_sf, aes(label = name),
               nudge_y = 0.15, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "br", which_north = "true",
                          style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering(),
                          height = unit(1.2, "cm"), width = unit(1.2, "cm")) +
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.3, unit_category = "imperial") +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(full_extent["xmin"], full_extent["xmax"]),
    ylim = c(full_extent["ymin"], full_extent["ymax"]),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    legend.position = c(0.98, 0.75),
    legend.justification = c(1, 0.5),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.85), color = "grey40")
  )
)



```
```{r}
ggsave("../figures/2026-07-07_MapBasedAccessType100mileRadius.pdf", plot = main_map, 
  width = 11, 
  height = 14, 
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,  
  bg = "white" )
```

          color = "steelblue4", linewidth = 0.4) +

          shape = 21, size = 2.2, color = "white", stroke = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = access_colors, name = "Access Type") +
  geom_sf(data = point_sf, shape = 24, size = 4,
          fill = "purple", color = "black") +
  geom_sf_text(data = point_sf, aes(label = name),
               nudge_y = 0.15, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "br", which_north = "true",
                          style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering(),
                          height = unit(1.2, "cm"), width = unit(1.2, "cm")) +
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.3, unit_category = "imperial") +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))
)
